moments.title: Sienna Spiro tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Rising star Sienna Spiro, 20, makes history with her first UK Number One single 'Great Expectation', becoming the youngest British female to achieve the feat in 12 years.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Big congratulations to Sienna Spiro on hitting UK Number One with 'Great Expectation'! What a moment for the 20-year-old.

angles.name: New Talent
angles.copy: Meet the UK's newest chart queen! Sienna Spiro is making waves at just 20, breaking a 12-year record for British female artists.

moments.title: Dolly Parton's Posthumous Chart Success
moments.blurb: Following her passing at 80, Dolly Parton's iconic hits '9 to 5', 'Jolene', and 'Islands in the Stream' re-enter the UK Top 10, showing a huge wave of public affection.

angles.name: Timeless Hits
angles.copy: Dolly Parton's music lives on! Her classics are back in the UK Top 10, a beautiful tribute to a true legend. What's your favourite Dolly track?

angles.name: Chart Icon
angles.copy: The Queen of Country is still dominating the charts. Dolly Parton's incredible legacy continues to shine, with her songs resonating stronger than ever.

moments.title: Manchester Derby: United vs City
moments.blurb: The first Manchester Derby of the Premier League season kicks off tomorrow as Manchester United host fierce rivals Manchester City at Old Trafford.

angles.name: Derby Day Build-up
angles.copy: It's derby day build-up! Tomorrow, Manchester United face Manchester City in the season's first huge clash. Who are you backing for bragging rights?

angles.name: Game On!
angles.copy: Old Trafford is ready! Man Utd vs Man City, tomorrow. Expect fireworks in this massive Premier League showdown.

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Action
moments.blurb: A packed Premier League weekend features Chelsea vs Hull, Liverpool vs Fulham, Tottenham vs Everton tomorrow, and Man Utd vs Man City on Sunday.

angles.name: Football Feast
angles.copy: The Premier League action keeps coming! Big games tomorrow and Sunday, including Chelsea, Liverpool, Spurs, and the Manchester Derby. What game are you most looking forward to?

angles.name: Weekend Kicks
angles.copy: Your weekend football fix is sorted! Tune in for all the Premier League drama. Any shock results on the cards this weekend?

moments.title: Worcester Music Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The UK's largest donation-entry festival, Worcester Music Festival, is live this weekend from September 11-13, with over 350 performances across 25 venues.

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Worcester Music Festival is ON! Three days of incredible live music across the city, all for a great cause. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Support Local
angles.copy: Discover your new favourite band and support local charities! Worcester Music Festival is live this weekend, check out the line-up!

moments.title: Reminisce Festival Returns
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest throwback dance festival, Reminisce, takes over Sherdley Park, St Helens tomorrow for a day of 90s and 00s anthems.

angles.name: Throwback Party
angles.copy: Get ready to relive the 90s and 00s! Reminisce Festival is tomorrow, bringing all the classic dance anthems to St Helens. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Dance Anthems
angles.copy: From rave classics to chart-topping dance hits, Reminisce Festival is set to be epic. What's your ultimate throwback tune you hope to hear?

moments.title: Waterworks Festival in London
moments.blurb: Waterworks Festival, a two-day celebration of electronic music, kicks off tomorrow, September 12-13, at Gunnersbury Park in London.

angles.name: London Dance
angles.copy: London's electronic music scene heats up this weekend! Waterworks Festival is back at Gunnersbury Park for two days of incredible sets. Who's going?

angles.name: Weekend Beats
angles.copy: Your weekend soundtrack sorted! Waterworks Festival brings a huge lineup of DJs to London. Get ready for some serious beats!

moments.title: Primal Scream UK Tour
moments.blurb: Scottish rock legends Primal Scream are on their UK tour, with dates running from today, September 11, to September 16 at various venues.

angles.name: Rock Icons Live

angles.copy: Still legendary! Primal Scream are on tour right now. What's your favourite track to hear live from the Scottish rock giants?

angles.name: Electronic Pioneer
angles.copy: Celebrating Moby's 61st today! From 'Play' to his activism, a true pioneer. Shout out your favourite Moby moment!

angles.name: Welsh Connection
angles.copy: A very happy 49th birthday to North Wales' very own Jonny Buckland, lead guitarist of Coldplay! Big celebrations for a local legend.

moments.title: Heritage Open Days Across England
moments.blurb: England's largest festival of history and culture, Heritage Open Days, is running from September 11-20, offering thousands of free events and access to hidden gems.

angles.name: Explore for Free
angles.copy: Unlock history this week! Heritage Open Days are on now across England, offering free access to incredible places and stories. Find an event near you!

angles.name: Hidden Gems
angles.copy: Ever wanted to peek inside a historic building normally closed to the public? Heritage Open Days are your chance, running until September 20th!

moments.title: London Design Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The London Design Festival, celebrating the capital as a global design hub, starts tomorrow, September 12, and runs until September 20 with installations and events across the city.

angles.name: Design Capital
angles.copy: London is buzzing with creativity! The London Design Festival kicks off tomorrow, showcasing incredible innovation and art across the city. What will you discover?

angles.name: Art & Innovation
angles.copy: Get ready for a week of groundbreaking design! London Design Festival starts Saturday. Keep an eye out for stunning installations and thought-provoking exhibitions.

moments.title: Welsh Teams in Championship Action
